text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government of Kenya declares national famine disaster in the country.
- Ugandan authorities detain five Kenyan fishermen for illegally fishing in the Ugandan waters of Lake Victoria.
- About 500 rioting students of St Mary's School in Nyamira district, Western Kenya beat up and strip their headmaster naked.

- The Japanese government extends to Kenya loans amounting to 7.3 billion shillings to be used in the development of the local energy sector and the expansion of the telecommunication system in the country.
- The High Court suspends the sale of five parcels of land belonging to Nyeri member of parliament Isaiah Mathenge valued at over 1.2 billion shillings.
